summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 29, 2026, announcing that the USPTO granted U.S. Patent No. 12,742,850 B2 on September 22, 2026, covering sensor fusion-based classification of calibration and maintenance events for its Phone Location Unit. The grant lifts SaverOne's portfolio to 23 patents, 17 granted and six pending, across the U.S., Europe, Israel, China and the UK. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are present; this is an ordinary IP announcement, incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 and F-3 registration statements. No risk-arb angle.
